verdict.rationale: The evidence never shows documented adapters or integrations for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. The MCP server is a generic, adjacent interface, and 'built in support for Claude, OpenAI... agents' describes model-native agents Hyperbrowser runs itself, not plugging its browser layer into external agent frameworks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters
